function decode(r) {
  if (r?.content || r?.result !== undefined || r?.data !== undefined) return r;
  if (!r?._readableState) return r;
  try {
    const chunks = Array.isArray(r._readableState.buffer) ? r._readableState.buffer : [];
    const bytes = [];
    for (const c of chunks) {
      const d = c?.data;
      if (Array.isArray(d)) bytes.push(...d);
      else if (d?.type === 'Buffer' && Array.isArray(d.data)) bytes.push(...d.data);
    }
    if (bytes.length) return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf-8'));
  } catch(e) {}
  return r;
}

  'Business Name: ' + cfg.bizName + '\n' +
  'Category: ' + cfg.category + '\n' +
  'Services/Products: ' + cfg.bizServices + '\n' +
  'Address: ' + (cfg.bizAddress || 'Contact us for location') + '\n' +
  'Phone: ' + (cfg.bizPhone || 'Contact us') + '\n' +
  'Email: ' + (cfg.bizEmail || 'Contact us online') + '\n' +
  'Target Customer: ' + (cfg.targetCust || 'Customers in the area') + '\n' +
  'What Makes Us Different: ' + (cfg.usp || 'Quality service and expertise') + '\n' +
  'Must-Have Features: ' + (cfg.mustFeatures || 'Standard features') + '\n\n' +
  '== OWNER\'S VISION — READ THIS CAREFULLY AND INFUSE IT INTO THE ENTIRE SITE ==\n' +
  cfg.vision + '\n\n' +
  '== DESIGN INSIGHTS FROM TOP 10 WEBSITES IN THIS CATEGORY ==\n' +
  'Dominant Style: ' + (analysis.dominantDesignStyle || 'Modern, clean, professional') + '\n' +
  'Hero Pattern: ' + (analysis.heroPattern || 'Full-screen hero with strong headline') + '\n' +
  'Key Differentiators of Top Sites: ' + JSON.stringify(analysis.keyDifferentiators || []) + '\n' +
  'Unique Features Seen: ' + JSON.stringify(analysis.uniqueFeatures || []) + '\n' +
  'Trust Signals That Work: ' + JSON.stringify(analysis.trustSignals || []) + '\n\n' +
  '== DESIGN INSIGHTS FROM TOP 10 WEBSITES ==\n' +
  'Dominant Style: ' + (analysis.dominantDesignStyle || 'Modern dark, premium, high-impact') + '\n' +
  'Hero Pattern: ' + (analysis.heroPattern || 'Full-screen immersive hero with 3D background') + '\n' +
  'Key Differentiators: ' + JSON.stringify(analysis.keyDifferentiators || ['Motion design','3D elements','Micro-interactions','Bold typography']) + '\n\n' +
  '== CDN LIBRARIES — INCLUDE ALL IN <head> BEFORE </head> ==\n' +
  '<!-- Google Fonts -->\n' +
  '<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">\n' +
  '<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>\n' +
  '<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=' + googleFonts + '&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">\n' +
  '<!-- Three.js r128 -->\n' +
  '<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>\n' +
  '<!-- GSAP 3.12 + ScrollTrigger -->\n' +
  '<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/gsap.min.js"></script>\n' +
  '<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>\n' +
  '<!-- Lenis smooth scroll -->\n' +
  '<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@studio-freight/lenis@1.0.42/dist/lenis.min.js"></script>\n\n' +
  '== MANDATORY CSS IN <style> BLOCK ==\n' +
  ':root { --bg:' + bg + '; --surf:' + surf + '; --pri:' + pri + '; --acc:' + acc + '; --txt:' + txt + '; --txt2:' + txt2 + '; --radius:16px; }\n' +
  '*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }\n' +
  'html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }\n' +
  'body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--txt); font-family:Inter,sans-serif; overflow-x:hidden; }\n' +
  '@keyframes marquee { 0%{transform:translateX(0)} 100%{transform:translateX(-50%)} }\n' +
  '@keyframes float { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-12px)} }\n' +
  '@keyframes pulse-glow { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 20px ' + acc + '40} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 50px ' + acc + '80} }\n' +
  '@keyframes fadeUp { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }\n' +
  '@keyframes countUp { from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1} }\n' +
  '.gsap-fade { opacity:0; }\n' +
  '#hero-canvas { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; }\n' +
  '.hero-content { position:relative; z-index:1; }\n' +
  'img { max-width:100%; height:auto; display:block; }\n' +
  '::-webkit-scrollbar { width:6px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:var(--bg); } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:var(--acc); border-radius:3px; }\n\n' +
  '== COLORS & TYPOGRAPHY ==\n' +
  'Primary BG: ' + bg + ' | Surface: ' + surf + ' | Primary: ' + pri + ' | Accent: ' + acc + '\n' +
  'Text: ' + txt + ' | Text2: ' + txt2 + ' | IsLight: ' + isLight + '\n' +
  'Heading font: ' + headingFont + ' (font-weight 700/800/900) | Body: Inter\n' +
  'ALL headings: color:' + txt + '; font-family:' + headingFont + ',sans-serif; font-weight:900\n' +
  'ALL body text on dark bg: color:' + txt2 + ' — NEVER leave text without explicit color\n\n' +
  '== HERO SECTION — THREE.JS REQUIRED ==\n' +
  'The hero section MUST have id="hero" with position:relative and a <canvas id="hero-canvas"> as first child.\n' +
  'Three.js creates an animated particle system on this canvas: 2000 floating points in color ' + acc + ', responding to mouse movement.\n' +
  'Hero content goes inside <div class="hero-content"> with position:relative z-index:1 so it sits above the canvas.\n\n' +
  '== ALL SECTIONS TO BUILD ==\n' +
  sectionInstructions + '\n\n' +
  '== JAVASCRIPT — ALL AT BOTTOM OF <body> ==\n\n' +
  'BLOCK 1 — Lenis smooth scroll (MUST BE FIRST):\n' +
  'const lenis = new Lenis({ duration:1.2, easing:t=>Math.min(1,1.001-Math.pow(2,-10*t)), smooth:true });\n' +
  'function raf(time){ lenis.raf(time); requestAnimationFrame(raf); } requestAnimationFrame(raf);\n\n' +
  'BLOCK 2 — Three.js particle hero background:\n' +
  'if(document.getElementById("hero-canvas") && typeof THREE !== "undefined"){\n' +
  '  const canvas=document.getElementById("hero-canvas");\n' +
  '  const scene=new THREE.Scene();\n' +
  '  const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75,canvas.offsetWidth/canvas.offsetHeight,0.1,1000);\n' +
  '  const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas,alpha:true,antialias:true});\n' +
  '  renderer.setSize(canvas.offsetWidth,canvas.offsetHeight);\n' +
  '  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio,2));\n' +
  '  const count=2000; const pos=new Float32Array(count*3);\n' +
  '  for(let i=0;i<count*3;i++) pos[i]=(Math.random()-0.5)*20;\n' +
  '  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute("position",new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));\n' +
  '  const mat=new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0x' + accHex + ',size:0.04,transparent:true,opacity:0.7});\n' +
  '  const pts=new THREE.Points(geo,mat); scene.add(pts); camera.position.z=5;\n' +
  '  let mx=0,my=0; document.addEventListener("mousemove",e=>{mx=(e.clientX/innerWidth-0.5)*2;my=-(e.clientY/innerHeight-0.5)*2;});\n' +
  '  (function animate(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); pts.rotation.x+=0.0003; pts.rotation.y+=0.0006;\n' +
  '    camera.position.x+=(mx*0.5-camera.position.x)*0.05; camera.position.y+=(my*0.3-camera.position.y)*0.05;\n' +
  '    renderer.render(scene,camera); })();\n' +
  '  window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{ camera.aspect=canvas.offsetWidth/canvas.offsetHeight; camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); renderer.setSize(canvas.offsetWidth,canvas.offsetHeight); });\n' +
  '}\n\n' +
  'BLOCK 3 — GSAP ScrollTrigger animations:\n' +
  'if(typeof gsap !== "undefined" && typeof ScrollTrigger !== "undefined"){\n' +
  '  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);\n' +
  '  gsap.fromTo("#hero h1",{opacity:0,y:80},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:1.2,ease:"power4.out",delay:0.2});\n' +
  '  gsap.fromTo("#hero p",{opacity:0,y:40},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:1,ease:"power3.out",delay:0.5});\n' +
  '  gsap.fromTo("#hero .cta-row",{opacity:0,y:30},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:0.8,ease:"power3.out",delay:0.8});\n' +
  '  document.querySelectorAll(".gsap-fade").forEach(el=>{\n' +
  '    gsap.fromTo(el,{opacity:0,y:50},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:0.9,ease:"power3.out",\n' +
  '      scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:"top 82%",toggleActions:"play none none none"}});\n' +
  '  });\n' +
  '  document.querySelectorAll(".gsap-counter").forEach(el=>{\n' +
  '    const target=parseFloat(el.dataset.target)||0; const prefix=el.dataset.prefix||""; const suffix=el.dataset.suffix||"";\n' +
  '    gsap.fromTo({val:0},{val:target,duration:2,ease:"power1.out",\n' +
  '      onUpdate:function(){el.textContent=prefix+Math.round(this.targets()[0].val)+suffix;},\n' +
  '      scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:"top 85%"}});\n' +
  '  });\n' +
  '  gsap.utils.toArray(".gsap-slide-left").forEach(el=>{\n' +
  '    gsap.fromTo(el,{opacity:0,x:-60},{opacity:1,x:0,duration:0.9,ease:"power3.out",\n' +
  '      scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:"top 80%"}});\n' +
  '  });\n' +
  '  gsap.utils.toArray(".gsap-slide-right").forEach(el=>{\n' +
  '    gsap.fromTo(el,{opacity:0,x:60},{opacity:1,x:0,duration:0.9,ease:"power3.out",\n' +
  '      scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:"top 80%"}});\n' +
  '  });\n' +
  '}\n\n' +
  'BLOCK 4 — UI interactions (hamburger, FAQ, tabs, counter, sticky header, dismiss bars):\n' +
  '// Hamburger\n' +
  'document.getElementById("hamburger")?.addEventListener("click",()=>document.getElementById("mobile-menu")?.classList.toggle("hidden"));\n' +
  '// Dismiss bars\n' +
  'document.querySelectorAll(".dismiss-bar").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>b.closest("[data-bar]")?.remove()));\n' +
  '// FAQ accordion\n' +
  'document.querySelectorAll(".faq-q").forEach(q=>q.addEventListener("click",()=>{const a=q.nextElementSibling;const icon=q.querySelector(".faq-icon");a.classList.toggle("hidden");icon.textContent=a.classList.contains("hidden")?"＋":"－";}));\n' +
  '// Tabs\n' +
  'document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener("click",()=>{const g=btn.dataset.tabgroup;document.querySelectorAll(`[data-tab][data-tabgroup=${g}]`).forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("tab-active"));document.querySelectorAll(`[data-tabcontent=${g}]`).forEach(c=>c.classList.add("hidden"));btn.classList.add("tab-active");document.querySelector(`[data-tabcontent=${g}][data-tabid=${btn.dataset.tab}]`)?.classList.remove("hidden");}));\n' +
  '// Sticky header\n' +
  'window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{const h=document.getElementById("main-header");if(h){h.style.boxShadow=scrollY>60?"0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)":"none";h.style.padding=scrollY>60?"8px 24px":"";}});\n' +
  '// Cart counter\n' +
  'let cart=0; document.querySelectorAll(".add-to-cart").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{cart++;document.querySelectorAll(".cart-count").forEach(el=>el.textContent=cart);}));\n' +
  '// Form submit\n' +
  'document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(f=>f.addEventListener("submit",e=>{e.preventDefault();const btn=f.querySelector("[type=submit]");if(btn){btn.textContent="✓ Sent!";btn.style.background="#22c55e";}setTimeout(()=>f.reset(),3000);}));\n\n' +
  '== IMPORTANT RULES ==\n' +
  '- Add class="gsap-fade" to every section card, heading, and feature block so GSAP animates them on scroll\n' +
  '- Add class="gsap-counter" data-target="50" data-suffix="+" to ALL stat numbers\n' +
  '- Add class="gsap-slide-left" to left-column content and "gsap-slide-right" to right-column content in 2-col sections\n' +
  '- Every image: <img src="https://picsum.photos/[W]/[H]?random=[unique-number]" alt="descriptive">\n' +
  '- NO dark text on dark background anywhere — every text element must have explicit color\n' +
  '- Every section must have id= attribute\n' +
  '- Footer last line: "Built with ❤️ by JHD Advisor — AI Automation & Digital Systems | jhdadvisor.com"\n\n' +
  'OUTPUT: Return ONLY the complete HTML starting <!DOCTYPE html> ending </html>. NO markdown. NO explanation. JUST the full production HTML file.';

const htmlRequest = JSON.stringify({
  model:      cfg.CLAUDE_MODEL,
  max_tokens: 16000,
  messages:   [{ role: 'user', content: htmlPrompt }]
});

console.log('[Prompt] category=' + cfg.category + ' vision=' + cfg.vision.length + 'chars light=' + isLight);

return [{ json: { ...cfg, analysis, colorPalette: cp, htmlRequest, isLight } }];
